sites.why: Rule 4: this.openai.chat.completions.create on a client built in Chat's constructor from the `apikey` parameter. In src/bot.ts loadChat (line 236), when OPENAI_API_KEY/GITHUB_TOKEN env is unset, the key is fetched per installed repository from that repo's GitHub Actions variable OPENAI_API_KEY via context.octokit (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/variables/{name}) -> per-tenant key. Endpoint is env-config defaulting to api.openai.com (OPENAI_API_ENDPOINT || https://api.openai.com/v1); optional env-selected branches go to Azure (AzureOpenAI when AZURE_API_VERSION+AZURE_DEPLOYMENT set) or GitHub Models (USE_GITHUB_MODELS=true -> models.github.ai, key=GITHUB_TOKEN). Model = env MODEL, default literal 'gpt-4o-mini' (catalog id; 'openai/gpt-4o-mini' on the GitHub Models branch), so rule 6 does not apply. Uses response_format json_object and reasoning_effort.
Generated ncc/rollup bundle (committed build output, action.yml main) containing a compiled copy of src/chat.ts's chat.completions.create; regenerated by `npm run build`, not hand-edited source.
